title: API keys and webhooks
description: Connect other apps to your school's data: API keys to fetch data, and webhooks to send a notice when something new happens.

apiKeys.description: An API key reaches the same endpoints a session does, bounded to the permissions selected when it was created.
apiKeys.revokeConfirmBody: The key "{name}" will stop working immediately. This cannot be undone.
apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key to give other apps access to this school's data.

create.dialogBody: Choose the permissions granted to this key. They can never exceed your own account's permissions.
create.noPermissions: Your account has no permissions to grant to a key.
create.shownOnceWarning: This token is shown once. Save it now; the server only keeps its hash.
create.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically, copy it manually
create.permissionsHint: {count, plural, one {# permission} other {# permissions}} selected. Only permissions you hold yourself.

webhooks.description: A webhook endpoint receives events as an HMAC-signed POST request.
webhooks.deleteConfirmBody: The endpoint "{url}" will stop receiving events. This cannot be undone.
webhooks.emptyBody: Add an endpoint to receive school events automatically.

form.dialogBody: The URL must be publicly reachable; a private or loopback address is refused.
form.eventTypesHint: {count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} selected.
form.secretWarning: This signing secret is shown only once. Store it in your receiver now to verify the X-Newsekolah-Signature header; the server keeps only an encrypted copy.
form.secretCopyFailed: The secret could not be copied automatically, copy it manually

deliveries.emptyBody: Delivery history appears once the first event occurs.

reason.timeout: The receiver did not answer in time
reason.unreachable: Could not connect to the receiver
reason.redirect_refused: The receiver redirected elsewhere; redirects are not followed
reason.endpoint_disabled: The endpoint is disabled, nothing was sent
